title: Changing number of seedling pots
observableEvidence: Explains a variable's possible values in a whole-number context and writes a matching expression.
prompt: A garden club has 3 extra seedlings. It puts 6 seedlings in each of n pots. Write an expression for the total number of seedlings. What values can n have?
solutionRepresentation: The total is 6n + 3 seedlings. Since n counts pots, n can be any nonnegative whole number.
solutionMethod: Multiply the changing pot count by six and add the three extras.

deterministicValidator.canonicalAnswer: 6n + 3; n is a nonnegative whole number
acceptedAnswers: 6n + 3; n is a nonnegative whole number
3 + 6n; n is a nonnegative whole number
deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept either addend order when n is restricted to nonnegative whole numbers.

hintSteps.prompt: n counts pots, so changing n changes how many groups of six there are.
hintSteps.question: What does six times n represent in this situation?
